analytics.savings_tip_desc: Switch {{count}} monthly subscriptions to yearly plans and save an estimated {{savings}}.
analytics.smart_tip_overlap_desc: You have multiple services in {{category}}. Pausing "{{name}}" if it's less used can free up about {{savings}} per year.
analytics.smart_tip_downgrade_desc: "{{name}}" makes up a big part of your spend. Moving to a lower tier could save around {{savings}} yearly.
analytics.smart_tip_renewal_desc: "{{name}}" renews {{when}}. If you are not actively using it, pausing before renewal could mean about {{savings}} yearly savings.

yearly_plan.title: Yearly plans save ~2 months
yearly_plan.desc: Services like Disney+, HBO Max and PlayStation Plus are clearly cheaper when paid yearly. Disney+ ad-free is ₺449.90/month but ₺4,499/year, roughly 2 months free. Switch services you'll keep long-term to yearly.

share_plan.title: Share a Family or Duo plan
share_plan.desc: Spotify Duo is ₺135, so ₺67.50 each when shared by two, about 30% less than Individual at ₺99. The same works for YouTube Premium, Apple Music and iCloud+ family plans.

student.title: Check student discounts
student.desc: If you're a student, Spotify Student is ₺55, almost half the individual price. YouTube Premium and Apple Music have student plans too; you just need to verify your status.

store_vs_web.title: Compare App Store and web prices
store_vs_web.desc: The same subscription can cost differently via the App Store and the service's website. Check the difference, especially for ChatGPT, Claude and YouTube Premium, before choosing how to pay.

carrier_bundle.title: Look for carrier and card deals
carrier_bundle.desc: Mobile plans and some credit card programs include digital subscriptions for free or at a discount. Check yours; you might get something you already pay for at no cost.

rotate_streaming.title: Rotate streaming services
rotate_streaming.desc: Instead of paying for several streaming services at once, keep only the one with the season you're watching, then cancel and switch. Most let you cancel any time.

free_trial.title: Add free trials right away
free_trial.desc: When you start a free trial, add it here and set the billing day to the trial's end. The reminder lets you cancel before an unwanted paid period starts.

annual_review.title: Review your list monthly
annual_review.desc: If there's a subscription you haven't opened in the past month, pause it. Turning it back on takes seconds; every unused month is money saved.

analytics.smart_tip_yearly_desc: You pay "{{name}}" monthly. Getting the {{plan}} plan yearly for {{yearlyPrice}} saves you {{savings}} a year.

new_sub.form_subtitle: Enter the amount, billing day, and category.
new_sub.next_payment_info:
Enter the next payment date. It's shown as the "renewal date" on the Subscriptions screen in the app store.

You can also enter the date of the most recent payment; the app calculates upcoming payments from it.
